doc: The places of the yard of the node (plan 0002, D6): the gate of the suppliers, the warehouse, a factory for the families of things, the site where the houses and the towers stand, and the hill of Núi Nhỏ where the statues stand. The positions are in meters on one flat plane (a place with a terrain has its true ground, plan 0006, D4); a truck drives on the yard at its speed limit. The people build the warehouse and the factories as houses of one floor with a shutter of the size of their products (D7).

places.name: gate
places.doc: The gate of the yard: the suppliers bring the materials, and rent a truck with its driver until the yard has its own trucks.

places.name: vehicles
places.doc: The line of the vehicles: the vans and the scooters.

places.name: workshop
places.doc: The workshop of the small things: the furniture, the items and the appliances.

places.name: site
places.doc: The site: a house or a tower is built where it stands.

places.name: nui_nho
places.doc: The hill of Núi Nhỏ (Tao Phùng) and the cape of Nghinh Phong, Vũng Tàu (plan 0006, D4): the true ground of the Vũng Tàu game (World.Terrain). The point of the place on the yard is the point of the lot top; each lot is at its point of the game. A statue is built here.

lots.name: top
lots.doc: The top of the hill: the statue of Christ of the game (landmark chua_kito_vua, OSM way 235008112). The turn of 180 (the statue looks to the south, to the sea) is an estimate from the drone video of plan 0005.

lots.name: cape
lots.doc: The cape of Nghinh Phong (landmark mui_nghinh_phong): the site of the first statue of 1972 (priv/history/tuong_chua_kito_vua_cong_truong.json). The turn is an estimate.

brick.source: A hollow clay brick of TCVN 1451:1998, 220 by 105 by 60 mm: about 1.6 kg (a data sheet of a maker of Việt Nam).

cement.source: PCB40 cement in bags of 50 kg; 7 bags for 1 m3 of concrete of B20 (an estimate of a mix of a site; the sand and the gravel are at the site).

rebar.source: A steel bar of 12 mm of TCVN 1651-2:2018, 11.7 m long: 0.888 kg/m.

mortar.source: A dry mortar for the render in bags of 40 kg: about 18 kg for 1 m2 of 10 mm (a data sheet).

paint.source: An emulsion paint for the walls in cans of 18 L, about 1.3 kg/L; 0.12 L/m2 for each coat, two coats (a data sheet).

roof_sheet.source: A corrugated steel sheet of 0.45 mm, 1.07 by 6 m with its coat: about 4.2 kg/m2 (a data sheet).

steel.source: A square steel bar of 14 mm, 6 m long: 1.54 kg/m.

trucks.source: The payload of a Ford Transit cargo van of 148 in: about 1,500 kg (Ford gives 3,000 to 4,000 lb by the model; an estimate).
